questions.question: What unusual command did God give Jeremiah in chapter 16?
options: Not to marry or have children in that place, as a sign
To fast and wear sackcloth for forty long days
To build a fine house and plant a great garden in the city
To leave the land and travel among the nations
questions.answer: Not to marry or have children in that place, as a sign

questions.question: What future hope does Jeremiah 16 give?
options: A new and greater temple raised on Mount Zion
A righteous king to reign over all of the nations for ever
Lasting peace among all the kingdoms of the earth
A return so great it will eclipse the exodus from Egypt
questions.answer: A return so great it will eclipse the exodus from Egypt
